preconditions.description: Number of days is between 1 and 50.
Number of stores is between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= s_i <= n-1 for s_i in s_list)
preconditions.description: Number of integers Dora bought each day is between 1 and n-1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= store_index <= n for store_index in dora_bought_list)
preconditions.description: Store indices bought by Dora are between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(dora_bought_list)) == len(dora_bought_list) for dora_bought_list in dora_bought_lists)
preconditions.description: Dora buys distinct integers from different stores each day.

postconditions.expression: all(lcm_dora > lcm_swiper for lcm_dora, lcm_swiper in zip(lcm_dora_list, lcm_swiper_list))
postconditions.description: For each day, the LCM of the numbers bought by Dora is strictly greater than the LCM of the numbers bought by Swiper.
